_note: Firm policy the engines read. Edit freely. The FINRA Rule 2210 threshold (25 retail investors) and window (30 days) are regulation and stay in lib/recipients/count.ts. Personalizable defaults (list size, signal weights, escalation days) live in data/profiles/firm.json. Servicing rules: first match wins, and money movement is checked first and always requires a callback (validate() fails otherwise). Its pattern errs toward flagging: a request that might move money is called back.

taxAssumptions._note: Illustrative marginal rates for the after-tax income column. A plan or a tax adviser supplies the client's own; the screen says which was used.

economics._note: Illustrative book economics for the Book economics agent. Fee rates by tier and hours per kind of work are placeholders a firm replaces with its own schedule and time records; every screen that shows a figure from here says so. Never client-facing.

retrieval._note: Deterministic retrieval. corpusDay is today on the corpus clock (documents carry a publication day on the same clock). floor is the relevance below which a passage is not shown as evidence; topK caps what one screen shows; citedBoost is added when the opportunity record cites the document; stalePenalty multiplies a document past its review date. In production a model rewrites the query and reranks; the floor, the citation and the refusal stay in code.

import._note: How a spreadsheet's holding columns map onto the shelf when a book is connected from a file. Product ids are data, never spelled in code.
